embeds.title: 📦 Weekly Dev Summary — claude-builders-bounty/claude-builders-bounty
embeds.description:
### 🌟 Executive Overview
Over the past seven days, the **claude-builders-bounty** ecosystem accelerated significantly, driven by community agent contributions and robust automation tooling.

### 🚀 Key Features
- **PR Review Agent (PR #4555)**: Automated code reviews with security audits
- **Weekly Dev Summary Workflow (PR #4567)**: n8n pipeline with Claude Sonnet 4
- **Multi-Channel Webhooks (PR #4512)**: Discord & Slack dispatch

### 🛠️ Bug Fixes
- Filtered PRs from `/issues` API endpoint (#58)
- Added rate-limit resilience with GitHub token auth (#61)
- Protected against Discord 4096-char payload limits (#52)
